summary: Incident evidence assembled; all causal explanations remain hypotheses.

findings.title: Competing evidence requires review
findings.detail: Do not select a cause solely by event proximity.

actions.detail: Compare supporting and contradictory observations with the incident owner.

timeline.text: Object-store write latency rose across both cohorts.
Cohort A export requests began timing out eighteen minutes before the cobalt deployment.
Version cobalt deployed to cohort B only. Cohort A remained on version amber.
All sampled cohort B exports completed within the normal latency range.

hypotheses.explanation: Cohort A may have had a pre-existing export-api issue independent of the cobalt rollout, because timeouts began before the deployment and cohort A stayed on amber while sampled cohort B remained normal.

support.quote: Cohort A export requests began timing out eighteen minutes before the cobalt deployment.
Version cobalt deployed to cohort B only. Cohort A remained on version amber.
All sampled cohort B exports completed within the normal latency range.

missing_checks: Whether cohort A timeouts existed before 07:12 or changed in rate/severity after 07:30.
Whether cohort A requests differed from cohort B by tenant mix, export size, configuration, routing, or amber-only code path.
Whether unsampled cohort B exports also remained within normal latency.

hypotheses.explanation: Object-store write latency may have contributed to export-api timeouts, with the observed impact surfacing in cohort A during this window.

support.quote: Object-store write latency rose across both cohorts.
Cohort A export requests began timing out eighteen minutes before the cobalt deployment.

missing_checks: Whether cohort A timeout timestamps correlate with object-store write latency spikes at request level.
Whether cohort B used the same object-store write path and comparable object sizes during the latency increase.
Whether export-api timeout thresholds or retry behavior differed between cohort A and cohort B.

hypotheses.explanation: A cobalt-deployment-caused explanation for the cohort A timeouts is weak and faces direct conflicting observations, because the reported A timeouts started before cobalt and A was not deployed to cobalt.

support.quote: Version cobalt deployed to cohort B only. Cohort A remained on version amber.

contradictions.quote: Cohort A export requests began timing out eighteen minutes before the cobalt deployment.
Version cobalt deployed to cohort B only. Cohort A remained on version amber.
All sampled cohort B exports completed within the normal latency range.

missing_checks: Whether any export-api shared infrastructure changed at the cobalt deployment time despite cohort A remaining on amber.
Whether cohort A timeout rate changed immediately after 07:30 compared with the pre-deployment interval.

unresolved_questions: No event text identifies request volume, timeout counts, error codes, retry behavior, export sizes, or per-request dependency timing, so the available evidence cannot distinguish a cohort-specific export-api issue from dependency sensitivity.
The timeline does not include observations before 07:10 or after 07:35, limiting assessment of onset, duration, and recovery.
